design.purpose: Rectangular trough planter for herbs/flowers. Serves 1 household: holds ~9 L soil, 15 cm deep soil for roots

steps.c: Measure and cut 40 cm base from wide board
Cut front, back, ends from narrow board
Stand front and back on base
Fit ends between front and back
Drill and screw front to ends
Screw back to ends and base up
